    "reading": "A warning becomes collective sorrow: peril for us, and a lamented manhood within the woman.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.41
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "dangerous ≈ danger-ous; French ou / English wo; woman ≈ woman / “woe-man”; sound-play joins danger, woe, and man",

    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.52
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",

    "confidence": 0.22
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "D A N G E R O U S / W O M A N = Dark Aspect Nurtures Grace; Every Ruin Opens, Unveiling Soul; Womb Of Mercy, Ancient Name",
    "reading": "A hidden acrostic of descent and mercy: danger opens the womb of meaning.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.18
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",

    "reading": "A threshold-figure: door, spiral, circle, serpent, vessel—woman as the passage where danger turns.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.33
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",

    "reading": "Eight: the figure of balance, power, and return; danger is folded into a completed cycle.",

  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "woman = Old English wifmann, “female person”; dangerous = from danger, originally lordship/power; together: female person under power",

    "languages": ["en", "la", "fr"],
    "source": "OED; Chambers Dictionary of Etymology",
